title: Action cameras gain momentum as camera demand fragments

Optical industry observers say consumers no longer expect one camera to cover every scenario, instead choosing specialized devices for specific uses—a shift that has made action cameras the clearest winner.

title: From LCD powerhouse to AI enabler: Taiwan's display industry reinvents itself after 30 turbulent years

title: IBM and Siemens collaborate to advance nanostack chip architecture

The work could influence chip performance, energy efficiency, and artificial-intelligence computing worldwide, as the companies seek to address design, simulation, lithography, and production challenges beyond the 7-angstrom node.

title: Von Ardenne's flexible equipment targets unsettled panel-level packaging market
content: German equipment maker Von Ardenne is entering the semiconductor industry with coating technology aimed at panel-level packaging, a segment where the choice among competing panel dimensions remains unresolved. Its tray-based systems can handle different substrate sizes without a new platform, potentially reducing equipment risk as manufacturers and customers worldwide weigh standards for advanced packaging and glass-based processes.
